rows.heading: The Backstage Guy
rows.body: from designing shows to managing them, from creating visuals to running them live, the music industry has always been my favorite place to work. forty-plus shows in the last four years and i'm still counting...

rows.heading: The one who plans it
rows.body:
i'm the guy in the group who plans and pushes everyone on tour. convincing people to commit isn't anyone's cup of tea. it needs ambition, patience, and a proper proposal. that's what i do.

from pre-estimating tour budgets to executing the entire plan fluently and effortlessly, i do it all. i'm the one who takes all the pain but still enjoys it the most because it's a smile on everyone's face that gives me mine...

photos.caption: the one who enjoys it the most

rows.heading: Miles and kilometers
rows.body:
cycling's been my thing since college. eight, nine years and twenty-five thousand kilometers deep. running just happened recently but it grabbed me hard. i do marathons when they're on, but running and cycling are weekend regulars now.

the dopamine hit, the rhythm, the endurance keeps me moving. music makes it all flow without much effort. i wish i'd started sooner, but honestly, better late than never. both keep me sane. that's where i think. that's where i live...

rows.heading: The duality
rows.body:
everyone around me thinks i'm an extrovert. the confidence, the way i speak publicly, how i lead. but it's all learned. i'm an introvert at my core. took years to practice being vocal in front of crowds. and yeah, i can do it now.

but that part of introversion is still inside me. i hate myself among a lot of people, a lot of unknown people especially...

i don't have any good photos of myself in my phone. in tours or hangouts, i'm the one mostly taking photos of other people. but since i've got this third eye for beautiful frames, when i see one, i'd love to have a photo of mine and it has to be sick.

always had a thing for those odd angles photos...
